MCP connector "Telegram - send a message" is deployed as
  http://{{ include "mcp-telegram.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.service.port }}/mcp

The api uses it only once it is listed as a global connector in the api
configuration (umbrella values):

  config:
    config:
      services:
        api:
          mcp:
            globalServers:
              - slug: telegram
                name: Telegram
                url: http://{{ include "mcp-telegram.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.service.port }}/mcp

Tenants then switch it on in "MCP servers" -> "Built-in connectors" (opt-in,
off by default) and enter their own bot token and chats under "Configure" —
tenant credentials never live in this chart.

Health:
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "mcp-telegram.fullname" . }} {{ .Values.service.port }}
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:{{ .Values.service.port }}/healthz
